---
  title: "Simulation Study"
  format: gfm
---
  
The scripts in this repository allow to reproduce the figures and table of the paper REF.
You may run the code below to install the necessary dependencies. 

```{r}
#| message: false
if (!requireNamespace("pak")) {install.packages("pak")}
if (!requireNamespace("parallel")) {pak::pkg_install("parallel")}
if (!requireNamespace("rgl")) {pak::pkg_install("rgl")}
if (!requireNamespace("spatstat")) {pak::pkg_install("spatstat")}
if (!requireNamespace("tidyverse")) {pak::pkg_install("tidyverse")}
if (!requireNamespace("patchwork")) {pak::pkg_install("patchwork")}
if (!requireNamespace("pracma")) {pak::pkg_install("pracma")}
if (!requireNamespace("spforest")) {pak::pkg_install("biscio/spforest")}
if (packageVersion("spforest")<"0.0.0.927") {pak::pkg_install("biscio/spforest",upgrade = TRUE)
}
```

To run the script `Table1.R`, the R deprecated package `RandomFields` is necessary. 
The user may install the last version from CRAN archive repository: 
<https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/RandomFields>.

Utility functions coded in the file `00_prelim.R` that should be placed in your working directory. Alternatively, download this full repository and open the `.Rproj` in Rstudio Then run the following chunk.
```{r}
#| message: false
source(file = "00_prelim.R")
```
